# Frontline Development Services Consulting Limited (FDSC)

> FDSC is a Tanzanian development and management consultancy. Since 2014 we have helped government, development partners, foundations, NGOs and businesses find out what works, strengthen the people and systems behind it, and prove the results. Based in Dar es Salaam. 28 assignments for 16 clients, in 23 of Tanzania's 26 mainland regions plus Unguja and Pemba (Zanzibar).

- Legal name: Frontline Development Services Consulting Limited (FDSC). Registered in 2014 under the Companies Act, 2002.
- Office: Victoria Noble Center, Plot No. 89, Block 45B, Kinondoni, Dar es Salaam. Postal address: P.O. Box 105471, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +255 786 266 441
- Email: info@fdsc.co.tz (alternative: fdscltd@gmail.com)
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 08:30 - 17:00 EAT
- Website: https://www.fdsc.co.tz/
- Clients and partners: Solidaridad East and Central Africa, Rikolto, HELVETAS Swiss Intercooperation, Ministry of Finance and Planning, The Nature Conservancy, Trias, Hanns Seidel Foundation, FEMINA Hip, Restless Development, Agricultural Markets Development Trust, Tanzania Coffee Research Institute, Tea Research Institute of Tanzania, Tanzania Bureau of Standards, Sugar Board of Tanzania, Tanzania Human Rights Defenders Coalition, Songas, Institute of Rural Development Planning
- Clients who have hired FDSC more than once (number of assignments): Solidaridad East and Central Africa (5), Ministry of Finance and Planning (4), Rikolto (3), HELVETAS Swiss Intercooperation (3), Sugar Board of Tanzania (2)
- Programmes FDSC has evaluated or supported were funded by the European Union, Irish Aid and the Belgian Development Cooperation (DGD), among others.

## Services

- [Programme and project management](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#programme-management): End-to-end design, planning and delivery support for development programmes and projects. Includes: Programme design and theory of change; work planning, budgeting and risk management; technical assistance to implementing units; donor reporting and compliance.
- [Research, monitoring, evaluation and learning](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#research-mel): Baseline studies, mid-term and final evaluations, and learning systems that drive evidence-based decisions. Includes: Baseline, mid-term and end-of-project evaluations; rapid appraisals and sector studies; M&E frameworks, indicators and tools; learning reviews and evidence briefs.
- [Gender analysis and mainstreaming](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#gender): Gender-responsive approaches built into policies, programmes and organisational practice. Includes: Gender analyses and audits; women's leadership and economic empowerment; gender-responsive M&E; youth and girls' empowerment programmes.
- [Organisational development and sustainability](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#organisational-development): Stronger institutional systems, governance and long-term sustainability. Includes: Strategic and corporate plans; governance and leadership reviews; resource mobilisation plans; institutional capacity assessments.
- [Training, mentoring and coaching](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#training): Practical capacity building for staff, boards, cooperatives and community groups. Includes: Results-based M&E training for MDAs; cooperative (AMCOS) governance and leadership; farmer and outgrower training; mentoring and on-the-job coaching.
- [Data management and analytics](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#data): Robust data systems and analysis that turn information into actionable insight. Includes: Survey design and digital data collection; quantitative and qualitative analysis; databases and dashboards; data quality assessments.
- [Performance management and development](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#performance): Frameworks and tools that align staff and organisational performance with strategic goals. Includes: Performance frameworks and KPIs; results-based management; staff appraisal systems; strategic plan monitoring.
- [Business management and entrepreneurship](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#business): Advisory and training support that helps MSMEs and entrepreneurs grow sustainably. Includes: Business development training; entrepreneurship for CSR programme beneficiaries; business planning and record keeping; access to finance and investment.
- [Agribusiness value chain management](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html#agribusiness): Stronger value chains, from smallholder production to market access. Includes: Coffee, tea, horticulture, rice and sugar value chains; certification and market access; soil fertility and climate-resilient farming; farmer organisation and outgrower schemes.

## Sectors

- [Agriculture and agribusiness](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html): Coffee, tea, horticulture, rice and sugar value chains: from smallholder farms and cooperatives to certification and export markets.
- [Governance and public sector](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html): Results-based M&E for ministries and agencies, EU-Tanzania cooperation, corporate plans and institutional strengthening.
- [Gender, youth and rights](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html): Women's leadership, girls' empowerment, youth programmes and support to human rights defenders.
- [Climate and natural resources](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/services.html): Water-resilient food systems, sustainable soil fertility and environmental conservation with farming communities.

## Selected work

- [Water and food systems that hold up in a changing climate](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): Mid-term evaluation of Rikolto's FICAP project across the Northern and Southern Highlands. Client: Rikolto. Where: Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Mbeya and Songwe. When: Aug - Sep 2025.
- [Getting Tanzanian coffee ready for export](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): Mid-term (2023) and end-of-project (2025) evaluations of Solidaridad's EU-funded PACE project. Client: Solidaridad East and Central Africa. Where: Ruvuma, Mbeya and Songwe. When: Jan - Mar 2025.
- [Five years inside the EU's AGRI-CONNECT programme](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): With FCG Sweden (now Cowater): tea, coffee and horticulture sector enablers, 2019-2024. Client: Ministry of Finance and Planning (EDF Programme Support Unit). Where: National. When: Dec 2019 - Dec 2024.
- [Horticulture businesses in the Southern Highlands](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): Baseline (2020) and final evaluation (2024) of Rikolto's EU-funded BICHOBS project. Client: Rikolto. Where: Iringa, Mbeya, Njombe, Songwe and Katavi. When: Nov - Dec 2024.
- [Measuring change for girls in Mwanza](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): Baseline survey for FEMINA Hip's Irish Aid-funded Nguvu ya Binti project, phase II. Client: FEMINA Hip / Irish Aid. Where: Misungwi and Sengerema, Mwanza. When: Nov 2019 - Jan 2020.
- [Healthier soils for Kigoma's smallholders](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/work.html): Training farmers in Uvinza District on sustainable soil fertility with The Nature Conservancy. Client: The Nature Conservancy (TNC). Where: Buhingu Ward, Uvinza District, Kigoma. When: Nov 2021 - Mar 2022.

## Frequently asked questions

- [What does FDSC do?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): FDSC is a Tanzanian development and management consultancy. We carry out evaluations, baseline studies and research, build monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, run training and coaching, and give advisory and technical assistance to government, development partners, foundations, NGOs and businesses.
- [Where do you work?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): Across mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar. Since 2014 we have delivered assignments in 23 of the 26 mainland regions, plus Unguja and Pemba. Our office is at the Victoria Noble Center in Kinondoni, Dar es Salaam.
- [Who have you worked for?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): 28 assignments for 16 clients, including Solidaridad, Rikolto, HELVETAS, The Nature Conservancy, Trias, the Hanns Seidel Foundation, the Ministry of Finance and Planning and the Sugar Board of Tanzania. Five of them have hired us more than once.
- [Which sectors do you know best?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): Agriculture and agribusiness (coffee, tea, horticulture, rice and sugar value chains), governance and the public sector, gender, youth and rights, and climate and natural resources.
- [What kinds of assignments do you take on?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): Baseline, mid-term and final evaluations, rapid appraisals, M&E frameworks and tools, gender analysis, strategic and resource mobilisation plans, training for staff, boards, cooperatives and farmers, and technical assistance to programmes.
- [How do I request a proposal?](https://www.fdsc.co.tz/contact.html#faq): Send us your terms of reference, or a short note on what you need, where and by when. Use the enquiry form, email info@fdsc.co.tz or WhatsApp +255 786 266 441. We reply within two working days.
